title: Asymptotically Exact Negative Guidance of Diffusion Models via Positive-Unlabeled Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19802v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Negative guidance of diffusion models generates samples that avoid an undesired condition, specified either by reference samples or by a conditional score alongside an unconditional model. Existing methods inject repulsive terms derived from local information at each sample, so the resulting sampler does not target an explicit density, and its bias cannot be systematically reduced by increasing computation. We instead present a negative-guidance method that samples from an explicit target density, which uniformly handles both reference-sample and score-based specifications and suppresses probability mass near the undesired condition with an avoidance strength that parametrizes the target density itself. Realizing this target requires estimating, at each diffusion timestep, how likely each sample is to belong to the undesired condition. translated_title: 基于正-未标记学习的扩散模型渐近精确负引导
translated_abstract: 扩散模型的负引导旨在生成避开某种不期望条件的样本，该条件既可以由参考样本指定，也可以由条件得分与无条件模型共同指定。现有方法在每个样本处注入由局部信息推导出的排斥项，因此所得采样器并不以某个显式密度为目标，其偏差也无法通过增加计算量而被系统地降低。与之相反，我们提出了一种从显式目标密度采样的负引导方法，该方法能够统一处理基于参考样本和基于得分的两种条件指定方式，并以一个参数化目标密度本身的回避强度来抑制不期望条件附近的概率质量。实现这一目标需要在每个扩散时间步估计每个样本属于不期望条件的可能性。我们将这一估计问题构造为一个正-未标记学习问题，该问题支持轻量级的在线训练。
tldr: 提出一种从显式目标密度采样的扩散模型负引导新方法，利用正-未标记学习在线估计样本属于不良条件的概率，从而实现渐近精确、偏差可通过增加计算量系统降低的负引导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an asymptotically exact negative guidance method for diffusion models that samples from an explicit target density, using Positive-Unlabeled learning to online-estimate each sample's likelihood of belonging to the undesired condition, enabling bias that can be systematically reduced with more computation.
